title: Hamming upper-tail indicator
statement: For a real number $t$, a natural number $n$, and a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define the upper-tail indicator to be $1$ if the normalized Rademacher sum of $x$ is strictly greater than $t$, and $0$ otherwise.
